Subject: Welcome, and the question I need answered
Message: Hi Selam, welcome to the team. I'll be direct. Ivy's dashboard shows a 31% conversion rate over the last four weeks, which looks great, but the franchise owners are furious and say Ivy is making things worse. The board meets in two weeks and I need to tell them whether we keep Ivy or switch it off. I've already quoted the 31% to our CEO. What is actually going on? Dana

Subject: RE: Welcome, and the question I need answered
Message: Dana, Selam, I've been reading about a new AI model that came out this month and its benchmark results are far ahead of what Ivy runs on. Ivy sounds robotic and I think that's the whole problem. Can we get a yes or no on switching by Friday? If it's yes, I'd like it live before the board. Marcus

Subject: Owner council notes: Ivy
Message: Dana, notes from last night's owner council call. 1. Owners don't care about reply rates. The only number we care about is paid memberships. 2. Several owners say leads are getting the same message twice and are annoyed. 3. Leads who ask to speak to someone at the studio are being ignored, and some of them are walking into the studio angry. 4. Eleven studio agreements renew in March. More than one owner said they will not pay for Ivy again unless this is fixed, and two are talking about leaving the network. We need a plan we can believe. Priya

To: Dana Okafor; Marcus Lee; cc Selam
Subject: Spending freeze until the board
Message: Hi all, a reminder that no new spending, contracts or vendor changes will be approved before the board meeting. That includes any new AI model costs. Changes that use existing budget and existing tools are fine. Tom

Subject: RE: Owner council notes: Ivy
Message: Selam, you'll have seen Priya's note. The board will ask one simple question: is Ivy worth keeping? I need an answer I can defend, with numbers. Please send me your recommendation in writing. I'll forward it to Marcus and Priya. Dana
